name: 0.5 - Acts I-IV and the three interludes
note: The guide pack for the Campaign Helper. Hand-written: each step's 'do' (style 2: written whole - verb first, the target, what you get, '→ where next', at most 70 characters; the app adds nothing to it), 'back' (coming back to a zone after a later step), the tips, the rewards and the vendor searches. 'ids': the game's area ids (matched before the name). 'early_ids': a first visit to the zone that has nothing to do yet. 'side': a detour off the story path (Speedrun keeps it only with its own 'speed' text). 'speed' / 'rush': the Speedrun and Rush (carry) texts - skip: left out. 'optional': shown only with Optional zones on. 'boss': who the zone's fight is with. 'last': the act's last boss (its death ends the act). 'island' (a 'hub' act): sailed to from the town, in any order. 'cues': the game's own dialogue lines in Client.txt per area id (s = a boss fight began, d = the boss is down, q = a quest moved on). A reward's 'cue': the area whose d line proves it; 'town': the NPC who gives it (asked once in town).
